title: Contended rollback leaks root slot and charge until Finish; accumulates into request-wide false negatives
claim: rollbackRoot uses rootsMu.TryLock and on failure keeps the rootID, rootCount and owner/process charge (and any published anchor) until Finish. Readers (Derive/putWindow, concurrent AdoptString, foreign Lookup) make it fail in correlation with the original failure; leaks exhaust the 2 MiB budget or 512 roots, and every later root in the request is dropped.

title: TaintBytes replacement zero-fills [len:cap] and breaks aliasing; public doc silent
claim: The clone copies only len bytes but keeps cap, so the tail is zeros and appends no longer write the caller backing array; taint.TaintBytes documents only same length and capacity.

title: Adopt pre-check rejections are not counted in drop telemetry
claim: AdoptString/AdoptBytes return false for len<2, oversize, or invalid key without incrementing any drop counter, unlike the Taint* constructors.

title: Root generations never advance in production; mutation invalidation path is test-only
claim: PublishBytesMutation/claimMutation have no non-test caller, so every production root generation is 1; generation wrap/ABA is unreachable and the described mutation invalidation is not live.

title: Process-wide overflow pool is first-come; one request can take all 256 blocks
claim: Overflow blocks have no per-owner quota, so one owner can force other requests multi-range roots to truncate to 10 ranges (within the documented guarantee).
